message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. Facts: Defendant Zhang pretended to rent a car, deceived victim Li to take his car, then pawned the car to friend and borrowed 15,000 RMB. Victim called to get car back, Zhang refused, fled. This is fraud (骗取财物) and also possibly theft? In Chinese criminal law, "诈骗罪" (fraud) is for deceiving to obtain property. He used false pretense (rent car) to get car, then pawned it. That's fraud. Also "非法占有他人财物" maybe theft? But theft is taking property without consent, not by deception. Here deception is used, so it's fraud. Also "非法占有" after obtaining by fraud, but the primary crime is fraud. Could also be "抢夺"? No. So charge: 诈骗. The correction rules: When listing the charge, output only the crime name without suffix "罪". So just "诈骗". No other crimes. So final answer: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>. JSON format: {"reasoning":"...","final_answer":"[罪名]诈骗<eoa>"}
